name: expense-card
title: Expense Card
description: A spending card with a period menu and horizontal bars on a dashed grid that grow in one by one.

perf.budget: Each bar grows once per change with a UI-thread spring; the grid and labels are static views.

a11y.reducedMotion: Bars appear at their length and the menu opens without zooming.
a11y.screenReader: The chart reads as one summary ("Housing 6.2K, Utilities 1.4K, Food 2.1K"); the period button reports whether its menu is open; options are menu items.
a11y.touchTarget: The period button and menu options are at least 44 pt.
